title: cyperus brevifolius
intro: Cyperus brevifolius, commonly known as Narrow-leaved Sedge or Short-leaved Cyperus, is a species of flowering plant in the sedge family (Cyperaceae). The plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cyperus brevifolius include its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve cough and cold symptoms, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
